description_en: Queries the list of threats on an instance
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka get-risk-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-pe335pgxxxxx --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetRiskList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_zh: 分页参数，起始索引大小
parameters.name: start_index

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the call is successful

RiskList.description_en: The list of threat items for the instance

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the threat was created. Unit: milliseconds

GradeType.description_en:
The metric rating. Valid values:

A: Healthy.

B: Suboptimal.

F: Poor
GradeType.description_zh:
指标评级。返回值有三种：
A：健康。
B：亚健康。
F：差

Health.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is healthy.
This is a Boolean parameter. Valid values:

true: The instance is healthy.

false: The instance is unhealthy
Health.description_zh:
是否健康。
布尔类型，返回值为：
true：表示健康
false：表示不健康

LastAlarmTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last alert. Unit: milliseconds
LastAlarmTime.description_zh: 上次告警时间戳。单位：毫秒

LevelType.description_en:
The risk level. Valid values:

0: Urgent.

1: Important.

2: Normal
LevelType.description_zh:
风险级别。返回值有三种：

0：紧急。
1：重要。
2：一般

ModifiedTime.description_en: The timestamp when the threat was last modified. Unit: milliseconds

Name.description_en:
The name of the threat item.

There are 24 types of names.

For more information, see the supplementary notes at the end of this document
Name.description_zh:
风险项名称。

名称有 24 种。
文档下面有详细的补充说明

RelationList.description_en: A cascading structure. The system determines whether to nest another layer of report data based on the values of outer fields
RelationList.description_zh: 无限级联结构，内部会根据外层字段判断是否再嵌套一层报告数据

ReportTips.example: 相关问题里的Topic存在碎片化发送问题，请参考文档进行优化

ReportType.description_en:
The report type of the threat item. Valid values:

topic: Optimization is required for a specific topic.

group: Optimization is required for a specific group.

doc: Optimization must be performed based on a document.

commonBuy: An upgrade or a similar operation is required for the returned threat item.

mdsKey: You only need to fix the threat based on the suggestions in ReportTips
ReportType.description_zh:
风险项的报告类型。返回值：

topic：具体到某个 Topic 需要进行优化。
group：具体到某个 Group 需要进行优化。
doc：表示需要按照文档进行优化。
commonBuy: 表示返回的风险项，需要进行升配等操作。
mdsKey：只需按照 ReportTips 中的建议进行修复即可

ReportValue.description_en:
The value of the report.

If ReportType is doc, ReportValue returns the document ID. You can construct the URL to the document by replacing the ${reportValue} variable in the following URL with the returned value: <props="china">https\://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props><props="intl">https\://www.alibabacloud.com/help/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props>

If ReportType is commonBuy, an upgrade or a similar operation is required.

If ReportType is topic, the value of ReportValue is the name of the topic that needs to be fixed.

If ReportType is group, the value of ReportValue is the name of the group that needs to be fixed.

If ReportType is mdsKey, you only need to fix the threat based on the suggestions in ReportTips
ReportValue.description_zh:
报告的值。


当 ReportType 为 doc 时，ReportValue 返回的是文档地址。用户可根据返回的值进行组装进行链接跳转，将返回的 ReportValue 的值替换即可访问文档地址： <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props><props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/document_detail/${reportValue}.html</props>
当 ReportType 为 commonBuy 时。表示需要进行升配等操作。
当 ReportType 为 topic 时，关注 reportValue 中的值，reportValue 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Topic。
当 ReportType 为 group 时，关注 reportValue 中的值，reportValue 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Group。
当 ReportType 为 mdsKey 时，只需按照 ReportTips 中的建议进行修复即可

Status.description_en:
The status of the threat item. This parameter indicates whether the threat has been fixed. Valid values:

0: To be fixed.

-1: Ignored.

1: Fixed
Status.description_zh:
风险项状态。表示是否修复该风险项。返回值有三种：

0：表示待修复。
-1：表示已忽略。
1：表示已修复

Type.description_en:
The type of the threat item.

There are 24 types of threats.

For more information, see the supplementary notes at the end of this document
Type.description_zh:
风险项类型。
风险项类型有 24 种。
文档下面有详细的补充说明

Value.description_en:
The value calculated by the system.

If ReportType is doc, check the relationList and value fields. The value field returns a number that indicates the number of topics or groups in the `relationList` field that require optimization.

When ReportType is commonBuy, check the value of Value. The value is a percentage.

When ReportType is topic, check the value of Value. The value identifies the Topic that needs to be fixed.

When ReportType is group, check the value of Value. The value identifies the Group that needs to be fixed
Value.description_zh:
系统计算出的值。

当 ReportType 为 doc 时。需要同时看 relationList  字段和 value 字段，value 字段会给返回一个数量，表示 relationList  字段中，有多少个 Topic 或 Group 需要优化。
当 ReportType 为 commonBuy 时。需要关注对比 Value 的值，Value 会给返回一个百分比的数值。
当 ReportType 为 topic 时，关注 Value 中的值，value 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Topic。
当 ReportType 为 group 时，关注 Value 中的值，value 值就是出现问题需要修复的 Group

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
